INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN.observed: Reader overlays every supplied complete frame and does not calculate checksums. Caller validates the checksum chain, stops at invalid salt/checksum, retains last commit prefix, and supplies only wal[..wal_len]. File acquisition is bounded by MAX_FILE and take(MAX_FILE+1). Caller additionally compares file length/mtime before and after reads.
INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN.result: Photo reuse claim requires caller-inclusive boundary; no missing-checksum upstream defect demonstrated

INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN.observed: Vec::with_capacity min(16MiB) limits reservation only; read_to_end remains unrestricted. HashMap insert overwrites duplicate paths. Missing include src/data continues. MT-462 already requires malformed IDML fail-closed and preservation/recovery.
INDEPENDENT_CHECKS_RUN.result: Existing adoption/proof gap confirmed; no executed exploit or memory measurement

COUNTERFACTUAL_CHECKS.statement: If lightroom_catalog.rs read_with_progress passed the complete WAL instead of wal[..wal_len], lightroom_sqlite.rs parse_wal would overlay checksum-valid-looking uncommitted frames after the final commit and could import uncommitted catalog values.
If import_idml_with treated Vec::with_capacity as a read limit, a ZIP part inflating beyond 16MiB would still grow through read_to_end and invalidate byte-budget admission.

If PdfCraft redact::apply omitted require_full_save, an incremental save could retain the previous revision containing removed content; a rendered black rectangle would not detect this byte-level failure.
If MT-200's four-value composer control were implemented as written, it could not independently represent world_ready plus single_line required by STU-TYP-135.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: IDML decompression is not bounded by initial capacity; duplicate canonical parts overwrite and missing parts skip. Design report correctly identifies source behavior. MT-462 already requires recovery and malformed fail-closed proof.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.mitigation: Enforce aggregate inflated/part/link budgets and duplicate identity policy before publication; test incomplete publisher document, cancel and restart through production importer, keeping all original preservation requirements.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: MT-200 retains superseded four-value composer acceptance; the active spec requires two independent fields and six combinations. Source greedy fallback further risks silent every-line substitution for long/tabbed paragraphs.
INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.mitigation: Preserve MT ID and original workflow intent; align representation and acceptance with current supersession, reconcile overlap with existing MT-30904/30905, and assert requested/effective compositor plus independent glyph/line/frame truth.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: Studio line20806 literally prohibits XMP sidecar files; STU-ASSET-019 line30701 inherits XMP read/write, and MT-411 repeats no sidecar. Photo final report now correctly labels interoperability-only exception as proposed clarification, not current authority.

INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.finding: A committed-WAL page reader is safe only under its documented checksum-validated prefix precondition. The current caller implements this. INDEPENDENT_FINDINGS.mitigation: Reuse validation, bounded acquisition and source-stability behavior together behind byte importer; strengthen snapshot/cancellation/global budget proof without adding SQL queries or durable foreign authority.
